'''Swarmers''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that were native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Karra]]. When gathered in large groups, these insects could temporarily blind or deafen anything caught in the swarm by flying into open orifices in the face. The native [[Karran]] people had learned to control the insects as war beasts, pitting the swarmers against enemies on the battlefield.
